description: FREE, no key. Position-size / risk calculator: account size, risk %, stop distance and point value -> risk amount, size rounded down to your lot step (optional max size cap) and actual risk. Informational only, not financial advice.

account_size.description: account equity in your account currency

point_value.description: value of 1 unit of size per 1 price point, in account currency

risk_pct.description: percent of account to risk on this trade, e.g. 1

stop_distance.description: distance from entry to stop, in price points

name: position_size
